en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I know I yelled at Angie
the other day...
<CLT=cltMIND>But I wasn't mad at *her*.

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to apologize.
She'll probably turn me down, but...

Yahoo! I wonder what we'll get up to today,
Shuichi.

<CLT=cltMIND>I thought she would be too mad to even
speak to me, but she's not acting any different.
<CLT=cltMIND>Alright, time to apologize.

Angie.
I'm sorry that I yelled at you before.
Huh? Why are you apologizing?

I'm over what happened.
Even Atua forgives you.
Ah? Atua did?
Yep.

But what about *you*, Angie?
Are you mad at me?

My feelings don't matter.
Atua has forgiven you, so it's fine.

Hey, Angie?
What is Atua...?

Atua is god, and god is Atua.
He is always with Angie.
Nyahahaha! How divine!
R-Right, but...

Hmmm? Do you wanna know more
about Atua, Shuichi?

It's okay, I'll teach you.
But only you, okay?

<CLT=cltMIND>Smiling even wider than usual,
Angie sidled up to me...
<CLT=cltMIND>and spoke in a low whisper...

The truth is, my works are divine
messages from Atua.
Divine messages...?

As an oracle, only I can receive Atua's
divine messages.
An oracle?

<CLT=cltMIND>She definitely does look possessed
when she's making her art. Could it be?

That's why it's my duty to tell everyone
on my island about Atua's teachings.

Atua's words are absolute, so everyone
listens to anything I say.
Anything?

Anything. One time, Atua suddenly told
me to throw a big festival...

Everyone on the island attended, and
we partied all week long.

It was so much fun, but since no one
worked for a week...
It kinda messed up our lives.
But Atua told me to do it, so that's that.

Atua gets lonely pretty easily.
Nyahahahaha!
<CLT=cltMIND>I...don't think so.
<CLT=cltMIND>I think Angie is the lonely one.

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie...believes that Atua's
will is her will.

<CLT=cltMIND>That means that everyone
will listen to her...

<CLT=cltMIND>That means that Atua will
take care of everything...
<CLT=cltMIND>But that's not right.

Hey, hey Shuichi? What's up?
Whatcha thinkin'?

Ah!
T-Too close!
Cuz I want you to focus on me.
Wow! I can see myself in your eyes!

W-W-Wait, Angie,
back up a little!
What? Why?
Why why why?

What do you mean, why?
You're really close to me, and...
I don't mind. I wanna be closer to you.
Nyahaha. There, now you're closer to me.

I don't mind being *emotionally* closer
to you, but can you scoot back a bit!?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Angie's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time being close and
getting closer to Angie...
